subject: maths
question: What is the present value of Rs. 9,360 at an interest rate 20% at the end of two years compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 9360

The rate = 20% . 

**Formula used:**

Amount ( A ) = Principal ( P ) × (1 + r / 100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

The present value is 9360 ( after 2 years ). In compound interest,

⇒ A= P × (1 + r / 100)n

⇒ 9360 = P × ( 1 + 20/100)²

⇒ 9360= P × 36/25 

⇒ P = 9360 × 25 / 36 = 6500 

**∴ The present value of Rs. 9,360 at an interest rate 20% at the end of two years compounded annually is 6500.**
